title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness! — Episode7 Wishing to the Blue Sky

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Episode: Episode7 — Wishing to the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, you two!
Our break's about to end!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Airi!
We'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's get back into focus and give it our best shot...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Shizuku and I had a chance to talk. I have a much better idea of what to do now thanks to her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (All that's left is for me to just be myself!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I might be a bit too excited right now. Maybe I should take a deep breath and...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane!
Sorry about running off like that. But I feel much better now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I learned what I was doing wrong after having a chat with Shizuku. From here on out, I'm gonna do my best to just be myself!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm still a little worried about overthinking things, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
In that case, An...
Would you like to sing with me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The truth is, An, I believe singing is what really allows you to just be you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The way you look so cool, have this incredible presence and sparkle as you sing is really, really awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, I thought we could sing together...
What do you say...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane went through the trouble of coming up with this idea for me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
Alright, let's do it...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Kohane put on an incredible performance during the Fan Festival, but I had no idea that they could be this powerful when singing together...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This must be her in her most natural state.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: It's just getting cloudier and cloudier... There's rain in the weather forecast too, so we probably don't have much time left to shoot under a blue sky...

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
Right...
I hope things turn out for the better somehow...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ms. Kawasaki! Ms. Kinuya!
Sorry about the wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I apologize for causing you so much trouble! But I feel much better now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should be able to show me at my best now!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Understood...!
Then, let's have another go at the scene in front of the chapel!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We have to really mean it with our wishes...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Please make it so Shizuku, Haruka and the others can just be themselves as they move forward together...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Please let An make her dreams come true alongside those she cares about so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
I don't believe it...!
They seem like completely different people now!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
I know, right...?
An and Shizuku look so spectacular now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. They're doing really great now!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Okay, this is good...!
However, I think we can squeeze in one more scene now that An and Shizuku have hit their stride.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright, let's move back to the courtyard and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?
Were some crows cawing at a cat just now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we came across a cat when we got here. Do you think they're fighting or something...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
There's a cat stuck in the tree...!
It's so high up too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's she doing here...?
Hang on... Can she really not get down?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, looks so...!
Why'd she climb all the way up there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no... What if that's where she ran after the crows started coming after her?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What do we do...?
She's so shaky and startled that she might lose her footing...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, we can't let her fall!
Wait, Ms. Kawasaki, can we ask to borrow a ladder from the staff...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea!
Let's ask and... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We don't have time to go borrow a ladder and come back...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (If Vivi falls, she's gonna get hurt really bad... Or worse...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, we absolutely can't let that happen!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, what are you going to do?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see if we can climb up the tree!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But your dress is going to make that very difficult. Why don't I give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
I can't climb it... I'm having too much trouble getting a good grip...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be tough even if we did manage to borrow a ladder...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That just leaves us trying to catch her as she falls, but there's no telling exactly where she's gonna drop down...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...!
If I use my skirt like this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, from that branch, she'll probably fall somewhere around...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
An, are you okay? Here, I'll help you up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Hehe. You've been a total lifesaver today, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hang on... You caught her with your skirt?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes.
I thought it'd make a good cushion and... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I got it all dirty... What do I do?
It doesn't look torn or anything, but jumping into the shrubs didn't do it any favors...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
I'm so glad you and the cat are both okay, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Kawasaki, Ms. Kinuya...
I'm so sorry. I...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry!
You worked so hard to make this dress too... I guess this means our shoot's...

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Hehe. Emergencies happen and clothes can always be washed. I can mend and sew things back together, but that's not the case with our feline friend here.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
She's right!
And regarding our shoot...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I just have to capture you as you are right now, An!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, because we all worked together and did everything we could to save this cat...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We became incredibly worried and all wished for her safety, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And now, we're all beyond relieved that she's back with us safe and sound...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This cat brought us all together and filled everyone with so much joy. Isn't this what Ms. Kawasaki was talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...!
I didn't realize something like this could bring us all together...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Vivi, if you rub your head against me like that... Y-You're tickling me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I believe this is her way of saying, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I-I'm glad she's happy but...!
Haha... H-Hey, I said that tickles...!
